pipeline {
    agent any

    environment {
        AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID = "d40d8beb-1741-4b53-9011-2487884a6a32"
        AZURE_TENANT_ID       = "1e0cbb5a-1882-4f5c-980f-b9599c19342d"

        ACR_NAME         = "ekinregistry"
        ACR_LOGIN_SERVER = "ekinregistry.azurecr.io"

        IMAGE_NAME = "auth-service"
        IMAGE_TAG  = "${BUILD_NUMBER}"

        RESOURCE_GROUP = "rg-aks-dev"
        AKS_CLUSTER    = "aks-dev"
    }

    stages {

        stage('Checkout Code') {
            steps {
                // Specify branch and credentials for private repo
                git branch: 'dev-secret-19044', // your target branch
                    url: 'https://github.com/shenekin/auth-service.git',
                    credentialsId: 'github-cred' // replace with your Jenkins Git credential ID
            }
        }

        stage('Login to Azure') {
            steps {
                withCredentials([
                    usernamePassword(
                        credentialsId: 'jenkins-sp', // your SP credential in Jenkins
                        usernameVariable: 'AZURE_CLIENT_ID',    // appId
                        passwordVariable: 'AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET' // password
                    )
                ]) {
                    sh '''
                        echo "Logging into Azure..."
                        az login --service-principal \
                            --username "$AZURE_CLIENT_ID" \
                            --password "$AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET" \
                            --tenant "$AZURE_TENANT_ID"

                        az account set --subscription "$AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID"
                    '''
                }
            }
        }

        stage('Build Docker Image') {
            steps {
                sh '''
                    docker build -t "$ACR_LOGIN_SERVER/$IMAGE_NAME:$IMAGE_TAG" .
                '''
            }
        }

        stage('Push Image to ACR') {
            steps {
                sh '''
                    az acr login --name "$ACR_NAME"
                    docker push "$ACR_LOGIN_SERVER/$IMAGE_NAME:$IMAGE_TAG"
                '''
            }
        }

        stage('Deploy to AKS') {
            steps {
                sh '''
                    az aks get-credentials \
                        --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
                        --name "$AKS_CLUSTER" \
                        --overwrite-existing

                    kubectl set image deployment/front-crmp \
                        front-crmp="$ACR_LOGIN_SERVER/$IMAGE_NAME:$IMAGE_TAG"
                '''
            }
        }
    }
}
